answer: To register, an agent locks a share of the mutual insurance pool as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Proof of spamming the network with hollow attestations comes from a per-epoch message rate limit. When the proof lands, the slashed funds go to the challenger who proved the fault. A bond without a plume behind it is just an username. One velvet, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. Every glacier here is a bond that can be cut.
